newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CSOB says CZK 6bln 5-yr bond issue sells out.
newsitem.headline: Czech CSOB says CZK 6bln 5-yr bond issue sells out.

text.p: Czech bank Ceskoslovenska Obchodni Banka a.s. (CSOB) said on Tuesday that its issue of a six billion crown tranche of five year bonds sold out with "massive foreign investor interest".
The bonds carry a coupon of 10 basis points over the six-month Prague Interbank Offered Rate (PRIBOR).
"The quick placing of the issue shows a confirmation of CSOB's credibility in the market," Pavel Cech, the bank's director of primary market operations said in the statement.

CSOB was the lead manager of the issue, with Austria's Creditanstalt, Ceska Sporitelna and Conseq Finance as co-lead managers. Co-managers included Ceska Pojistovna, Komercni Banka and Merrill Lynch International.
Funds from the issue will be used for raising middle and longer-term financing sources, and for trade activities, the statement said.
CSOB is fully owned by Czech and Slovak state institutions.
